2. SCOPE OF WORK EXECUTED
Bridges Flyovers works for Jharkhand Municipal Corporation completed 2013.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included expansive clay in the sub-grade
requiring additional treatment. The agency organised its resources around this without
recourse to the department for additional assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced
locally to keep the critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of late availability of the client-
supplied cement consignment. The delay was examined by this office and held to be beyond
the agency's control; no compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the
approved drawings, specifications, and the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has
been completed in all respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief /
Superintending Engineer.

3. QUALITY ASSESSMENT
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Excellent. Workmanship was good, with
finishing standards above the specified norm, and final inspection was completed in the
presence of the client's representative. Materials were drawn from approved sources and the
test results filed with this office were within the limits prescribed in the contract specification.

5. DEFICIENCY / OBSERVATION LIST
At the time of taking over, minor honeycombing on one abutment face, since made good.
Regarding site safety, no lost-time injury was reported over the contract period. The agency's
conduct during the contract is recorded as professional, though correspondence on variations
was occasionally slow.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2013-06-01. All
minor observations pointed out during the interim inspections have been rectified to the
satisfaction of the inspecting authority.
6. RECOMMENDATION
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of
the joint measurements recorded in the measurement book, I certify the work complete and
recommend release of the balance payment together with the retention money due on expiry
of the defect liability period. Certified by K. Nair, Project Director.
The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and
contract conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection
carried out by the undersigned.
This certificate is issued for the sole purpose of recording completion of the above work and does not absolve the
contractor of any obligations under the contract, including the defect liability period.
